ask: Users want to see agent progress and intervene during long delegated work.
plugin: SubagentStart/Stop and tool hooks maintain a progress ledger; a statusline or experimental UI hook displays activity and a command requests pause or handoff.

ask: Users want reminder tags available when creating or updating tasks.
plugin: An MCP server wraps Apple Reminders to expose tags as explicit fields.

ask: Users want generated commits and PRs to honor their attribution preference.
plugin: An attribution.text function hook or PreToolUse guard rewrites or blocks unwanted commit trailers and injects configured dynamic fields.

ask: Users want DWG and DXF files usable in architectural workflows.
plugin: An MCP server parses CAD drawings and exposes structured geometry inspection and conversion tools.

ask: Users want image paste in the terminal input.
plugin: Experimental ui.input hooks receive clipboard image data and attach it to the prompt.

ask: Users want ignore rules generated for the project type.
plugin: A skill inspects the repository and a bin utility writes a reviewed .claudeignore template.

ask: Users want convenient aliases, completion, and custom commands for common CLI actions.
plugin: Namespaced skills and command.describe/command.run function hooks add shortcuts, ordering, hints, and exact-match behavior.

ask: Users want long sessions to preserve task state, decisions, and instructions across compaction or clearing.
plugin: A skill and PreCompact/PostCompact hooks persist pinned facts and a task ledger, then restore them after a clear or compact.

ask: Users want to personalize terminal companions, including appearance, name, language, and behavior.
plugin: Experimental ui.render and companion event hooks replace supported terminal visuals and add a configurable companion profile.

ask: Users want a persistent companion game with unlocks and progression.
plugin: Experimental UI hooks and plugin data storage track companion levels, unlocks, and optional interactions.

ask: Users want graphical applications available to Claude Code.
plugin: An MCP server exposes screenshot, click, keyboard, and element inspection tools.

ask: Users want early, accurate warnings and visibility into context consumption.
plugin: A statusline and monitor display context and token use, forecast exhaustion, and warn before a session becomes unrecoverable.

ask: Users want portable conversation history across clients and devices.
plugin: A command exports local transcripts and context briefs with redaction; an MCP bridge imports the portable artifact where the target client permits it.

ask: Users want to control when and how conversation context is compressed or cleared.
plugin: Experimental session.measure and session.compact hooks tune compaction policy, hold a requested compact, and rewrite its instructions; native early triggering still depends on the host threshold.

ask: Users want current package release knowledge during coding.
plugin: A monitor fetches tracked package release feeds and an MCP tool returns versioned changelogs on demand.

ask: Users want a plan turned into a Directus schema.
plugin: A skill validates the plan and a Directus MCP server applies the reviewed collection schema.

ask: Users want temporary sessions without retained local history.
plugin: SessionEnd hooks and a bin launcher isolate temporary transcript storage and remove it after the session ends.

ask: Users want to download files and images from Feishu.
plugin: An MCP server supplies a Feishu media download tool and stores fetched files locally.

ask: Users want explicit checks before risky Git operations or unapproved file changes.
plugin: PreToolUse hooks enforce an approved edit scope, require review or a completion checklist before Git writes, and block accidental generated files.

ask: Users want Google Sheets available as agent tools.
plugin: An MCP server exposes spreadsheet read, write, and search actions with a skill for safe sheet editing.

ask: Users want iCloud calendar available as agent tools.
plugin: An MCP server exposes calendar queries and edits using an authorized iCloud connection.

ask: Users want oversized images compressed before they block a conversation.
plugin: A bin utility resizes and recompresses local images, with a PreToolUse hook substituting an approved smaller file.

ask: Users want project rules and explicit constraints checked before the agent acts.
plugin: A rules skill and PreToolUse/Stop hooks check proposed actions and final claims against explicit project constraints.

ask: Users want reliable editing of JAR and other binary artifacts.
plugin: A bin executable parses and patches binary archives, with a skill for review and validation.

ask: Users want a deep interview to produce Jira work items.
plugin: An interview skill gathers requirements and a Jira MCP server creates the resulting issues.

ask: Users want an autonomous web research workflow for leads.
plugin: An agent combines browsing and extraction tools to produce a source-linked lead list.

ask: Users want plugin and MCP installation, state, and health visible from automation.
plugin: A monitor and command inspect plugin and MCP state, detect stale or disconnected tools, and offer a controlled reconnection workflow.

ask: MCP services need to distinguish sessions and expose rate-limit state to automation.
plugin: An MCP wrapper and tool.call function hook attach a stable session identifier and surface rate-limit metadata to tools that accept it.

ask: Users want Telegram and Discord messages to preserve formatting and support dispatch.
plugin: A channel-bound MCP server bridges these chat systems and formats Telegram MarkdownV2 messages.

ask: Users want automated mobile app UI tests derived from the codebase.
plugin: An agent analyzes screens and runs tests through a mobile automation MCP server.

ask: Users want model and reasoning effort chosen or held by task, activity, and session.
plugin: Experimental turn.step hooks choose model and effort from task phase and local policy, with a command for explicit override.

ask: Users want clearer, localized, or accessible assistant output.
plugin: Output styles and skills apply chosen language, tone, and vocabulary; a voice MCP or bin adapter supplies custom transcription vocabulary.

ask: Users want sessions and memory to survive moving repositories or switching machines.
plugin: A bin utility exports and imports project transcripts, memory, and user instructions, mapping relocated repository identities and syncing only chosen files.

ask: Users want feedback records and reporting that preserve their preferences and privacy.
plugin: A command stores local drafts and submission history, previews redaction, and sends approved feedback through a configured endpoint.

ask: Users want durable, searchable project or team memory with explicit scope, freshness, and pruning.
plugin: An MCP memory store and SessionStart/Stop hooks capture approved facts, rank them by recency and topic, and retrieve only relevant entries.

ask: Users want project and personal skill sets without committing local instructions.
plugin: SessionStart hooks load gitignored project-local skill and agent definitions and a command switches named profiles.

ask: Users want noisy system context, tool metadata, or redundant reads reduced.
plugin: Experimental prompt.section and tool.describe hooks trim hidden prompt and tool overhead; a statusline exposes the measured cost.

ask: Users want related files updated when code changes.
plugin: An agent uses code search and LSP references to propose companion edits, with a Stop hook flagging missed references.

ask: Users want to start, inspect, or hand off local sessions from other devices and processes.
plugin: An opt-in monitor and MCP server track local sessions, publish liveness, and expose safe attach or handoff operations to remote clients.

ask: Users want plans and specs available as rich HTML previews.
plugin: A bin renderer converts Markdown plans to local HTML with syntax highlighting and diagrams.

ask: Users want reviews, source checks, and proof of completed work before an answer.
plugin: A review agent and Stop hook verify changes against tests and source evidence, while a command opts selected PRs into review.

ask: Users want rules, memory, and environment guidance loaded at the right scope and time.
plugin: SessionStart, CwdChanged, and UserPromptSubmit hooks load scoped rules and memory, select branch or topic profiles, and gate memory writes.

ask: Users want durable, observable scheduled tasks and background work.
plugin: A monitor with a local durable job ledger schedules runs, exposes status and cancellation, and manages follow-up handoffs.

ask: Users want browser screenshots saved directly as files.
plugin: A wrapper MCP tool calls the browser screenshot capability and writes the returned image to a selected local path.

ask: Users want a reproducible handoff or checkpoint between sessions and collaborators.
plugin: A skill and command save checkpoints, fork a task brief, and seed a parallel session with its goals and completed work.

ask: Users want a chosen working directory, plan location, and resume behavior at launch.
plugin: A bin launcher sets cwd, stores plans relative to the project, and resumes the selected local session.

ask: Users want to find, label, link, and navigate sessions and branches easily.
plugin: A command and bin index local sessions, assign stable names and labels, and offer a searchable resume picker; UI tab titles need experimental function hooks.

ask: Users want Slack actions missing from the existing connector.
plugin: An MCP server wraps Slack APIs to unsave messages and read or write Lists, exposing namespaced tools.

ask: Users want inspectable events and useful diagnostics for long sessions and failed tools.
plugin: Lifecycle hooks record skill, tool, and session events with identifiers and timings; a command produces project-scoped reports.

ask: Users want to customize the terminal welcome, spinner, tips, and session status.
plugin: A theme, statusline, and experimental UI hooks customize terminal colors, spinner, session state, and supported display elements.

ask: Users want granular tool permissions, remote approvals, and secret handling.
plugin: PermissionRequest/PreToolUse hooks enforce tool-specific policy and route approval; an MCP vault supplies scoped secrets without model-visible values.

ask: Users want to retain, back up, archive, search, delete, and export local session history on their terms.
plugin: A SessionEnd hook and bin utility back up local transcripts, index attachments, and offer archive, search, and cleanup commands.

ask: Users want local visibility into token spend, limits, and session usage.
plugin: A statusline and local monitor display usage, per-project spend, reset times, and configurable warnings using exposed usage data.

ask: Users want hands-free voice interaction, transcription options, and durable voice settings.
plugin: An audio MCP server or bin executable handles recording and transcription; SessionStart hooks apply saved preferences, with native voice UI gaps treated as workarounds.

ask: Users want the agent to stay in the intended worktree and avoid destructive cleanup.
plugin: PreToolUse and WorktreeRemove hooks verify the active worktree, branch, path, and pending edits before writes, pushes, or cleanup.

ask: Users want Claude to participate in Zoom meetings.
plugin: An MCP server joins meetings through supported Zoom APIs and relays transcript and approved actions to a meeting skill.
